# Request Sheet

Request Sheet is a local-first static web utility for service businesses. Owners create a constrained item list and share it by URL. Clients select quantities, add minimal contact details and requirements, then export a non-binding request draft as CSV, PDF or JSON. It is not a storefront, payment tool, inventory system or automatic quote acceptance service.

Public pages:
- / — product and sheet builder
- /privacy — local data and license verification policy
- /terms — use and purchase terms
